request.raw_text: Change the current plug for Europlug with two round pins and try to copy the real shape.

aim.primary_aim: Replace the current plug geometry with a realistically shaped Europlug having two round pins.

functional_design_intentions.name: Europlug compatibility
functional_design_intentions.description: The plug should have the recognizable form and mating geometry of a real Europlug.

functional_design_intentions.name: Realistic representation
functional_design_intentions.description: The final plug should visually and geometrically resemble the real-world Europlug shape rather than a generic plug.

required_relationships.reference: the two round pins are parts of the Europlug

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: all model geometry other than the current plug
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve non-targeted geometry and its existing placement under a minimum-change rule.

geometry.description: The current plug is replaced by a realistically shaped Europlug with two round pins.

relationships.reference: two round pins belonging to the Europlug

functions.name: Europlug interface
functions.description: Provide the recognizable plug geometry intended to mate with a Europlug-compatible receptacle.

behaviors.name: Two-pin mating
behaviors.description: The two round pins permit insertion into corresponding round receptacle openings in the manner of a Europlug.

validation_criteria.description: The final model contains a Europlug in place of the current plug.
The Europlug has exactly two pins.
The plug body and pins resemble the shape of a real Europlug.
The resulting geometry represents an interface intended for a Europlug-compatible receptacle.
The two round pins are arranged to permit Europlug-style insertion into corresponding receptacle openings.
Non-targeted model geometry and its existing placement remain unchanged except where required to replace the plug.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not provide an exact Europlug standard, dimensional specification, scale, or physical reference from which the real shape can be copied.
candidate_interpretations: Use the standard CEE 7/16 Europlug form.
Use a specific real Europlug product as the shape reference.
Create a visually realistic Europlug without enforcing unspecified standard dimensions.

unresolved_requirements.description: The extent of the current plug geometry to be replaced and its attachment interface to the rest of the model are not identified.
candidate_interpretations: Replace the entire current plug while preserving its existing attachment location.
Replace only the exposed plug body and pins while retaining an existing mounting or connection interface.
